Magnificent street-level commercial premises for rent with 375 m² built (348 m² usable) spread over 4 highly functional floors. Located a step away from the Avenida de América transport hub and the heart of Prosperidad. Layout and features: 12 spacious and bright rooms: Adaptable as executive offices, meeting rooms, service booths, or open-plan areas. 2 large display windows: Excellent street-level visibility to boost your business's brand image. 3 restrooms/bathrooms: Convenience for employees and clients. Complete equipment: Air conditioning and climate control installation. Independent storage/archive space. Active alarm system. Condition: In good state of repair. Surroundings and Communications: Strategic location with continuous pedestrian and vehicle traffic. Direct connection to the Metro (L4, L6, L7, L9) and intercity buses at Avenida de América, facilitating access for your entire team and clients. Ideal for companies, clinics, professional offices, or educational centers. Call us without obligation to arrange a visit. Must be seen. TAXES NOT INCLUDED IN THE FINAL SALE PRICE. PHOTOGRAPHS OF THE PREMISES ARE NOT INCLUDED BY DECISION OF THE OWNER; INTERESTED PARTIES MUST PRESENT AN NDA.
